subject: Handover playlist: canary pathway + eval slate for Caldera Therapeutics
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-07T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Handover playlist: canary pathway + eval slate for Caldera Therapeutics

Team —

We closed Caldera last week; signing completed Thursday. Amelia asked for a tight, single-page MAP that embeds the canary strategy, migration steps, and the eval suite they want run during the pilot. I drafted a concise playlist and attached a first-pass MAP (CALD-MAP-v1.2.pdf) and a canary checklist.

Key asks from Sales/AM:
- Concrete 2-week canary window aligned to their dev release (target kickoff 2028-09-26)
- Minimal training for 12 end-users + 2 super-users
- Eval slate: latency / correctness / hallucination sample set (50 prompts) and rollback criteria

Proposed owners:
- Rollout orchestration & canary gating: Evelyn
- Migration checklist & infra handoff: Karthik
- CS training and acceptance: Marissa

Amelia is fine with a staged approach but wants dates in the MAP and a short mutual sign-off cadence (they prefer DocuSign for the MAP appendix). Please review the draft and flag anything that would block the 9/26 canary kickoff.

Thanks —
Ben

Attachments: CALD-MAP-v1.2.pdf (MAP draft), canary-checklist-2028-09.xlsx (checklist)

From: Amelia Torres <amelia.t@calderatx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Caldera Therapeutics - Implementation Team <impl-team@calderatx.com>
Date: 2028-09-07T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handover playlist: canary pathway + eval slate for Caldera Therapeutics

Thanks, Ben — this looks promising. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Canary window: 2028-09-26 to 2028-10-09 works if we keep traffic routed to existing inference service for traffic below 5% and ramp to 25% by day 4.
2) Training: we can do two 60-minute sessions (one for super-users, one for general users). Prefer in-person for super-users if possible; remote is fine for the rest.
3) Eval slate: the 50 prompts are good — can you add 10 prompts that specifically exercise our billing reconciliation flow?
4) DocuSign: please send the MAP appendix as a DocuSign envelope and we’ll sign within 48 hours.

We looped our infra lead (impl-team) for any firewall/VPC items. Minor ask: can the MAP show the fallback model variant (quantized) we'll use if the primary model drops below 90% token availability?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Amelia

Attachment: internal:caldera-release-calendar.ics (referenced)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-08T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handover playlist: canary pathway + eval slate for Caldera Therapeutics

All —

I reviewed the MAP draft and made three edits (see CALD-MAP-v1.2.pdf: redlines). Highlights:
- Inserted explicit canary gating rules (ramp thresholds: 5% day1 / 25% day4 / 50% day7) and rollback triggers (latency > 250ms p95 OR error rate > 1% sustained for 10 min).
- Added the fallback model variant and the quantization note Amelia requested.
- Added a minimal KV cache warmup step to avoid cold-start token spikes during ramp.

Karthik — can you confirm infra prerequisites (VPC peering, allowed IP ranges, KMS key for logs) and answer whether we need a maintenance window to import the KV cache pre-cutover? If yes, propose dates.

Marissa — I’ll need the 10 billing reconciliation prompts added to the eval set; can you own that and put them into the shared Drive folder?

I’ll package the MAP appendix for DocuSign after we get those items confirmed.

Thanks —
Evelyn

Quoted previous message below for context.

On Sep 7, 2028, at 09:02, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote: > Team — We closed Caldera last week; signing completed Thursday...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-09T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handover playlist: canary pathway + eval slate for Caldera Therapeutics

Evelyn —

We can meet the listed infra prerequisites. Quick notes:
- VPC peering request can be completed 2028-09-18; need their public subnet ranges and one point of contact from impl-team.
- KMS provisioning for log encryption will take 3 business days once we have the KMS ARN.
- KV cache warmup: we should schedule a 45-minute maintenance window on 2028-09-25 (evening UTC) to pre-populate the prefix cache with their top-1000 queries. That avoids a cold burst during day 1 ramp.

No additional maintenance window required for the model import — we’ll use a staged instance that receives traffic only after successful warmup and smoke tests.

I’ll add these dates to the MAP and push the updated checklist to the Drive link.

—Karthik

Attachment: infra-prereqs-summary.txt (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-09-12T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handover playlist: canary pathway + eval slate for Caldera Therapeutics

Amelia —

Thanks for the quick feedback. I uploaded 10 billing-reconciliation prompts to the shared Drive folder (link in the MAP) and annotated them with expected outcomes and tolerance bands. I also created two training sessions:

- Super-user deep-dive: 2028-09-24 10:00–11:00 PT (in-person at SF office; dial-in available)
- End-user overview + Q&A: 2028-09-26 14:00–15:00 PT (remote)

Evelyn — I confirmed the DocuSign envelope will go out once Karthik confirms the peering CIDRs and we attach the infra-prereqs-summary. Ben — can you please ready the HubSpot deal notes (Deal 10234-CT) with the finalized MAP timeline for Amelia?

Amelia — once the map is in DocuSign we’ll aim to have the MAP appendix signed within 48 hours as requested. Please reply here if the super-user session needs to be earlier.

Best —
Marissa
